name: Desecrate Battlefield
body:
School evocation [evil]; Level cleric/oracle 6, inquisitor 6

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M (a vial of unholy water and 1 pound of platinum dust worth 500 gp)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 feet + 10 feet per level)
Area 100-ft.-radius emanation
Duration 1 day/level

DESCRIPTION

You fill the battlefield with negative energy. This spell functions as desecrate, except as above.

This spell counters and dispels consecrate and consecrate battlefield.
